hook: New Zealand made 259 today. It's not a one-off.
lines: 4 of the 6 biggest totals India have conceded in T20Is came this year.
India's bowling was the best of the top 10 sides on runs above par. In 2026, it's 6th.
The biggest change is spin: from well above par to well below it.
Fewer balls on a good length, and those cost 8.1 an over, up from 6.5.
And at the death, 11.4 an over, from 8.6.
